title: marketing
text:
marketing

Alex K: ok team — we need to lock the webinar topic and a tight run-of-show by EOD tomorrow. goal: actionable ops for shipping cost-efficient fall launches. short, tactical, demo-forward.
Olivia: +1. propose we frame it as 'Routing, fallbacks, and demo economics' — opens with a quick case (20k qps -> cost drop) then live bench.
Maria: love that. speakers? can we get someone from infra + product + a customer?
Samir: i can cover the runtime optimizations/quantization bit.
Jordan: I can do the customer perspective (we ran Redwood Dedicated).
Alex K: perfect. Olivia can you draft a 2-sentence abstract we can use for the invite?
Olivia: draft below — please react with thumbs if we can use it: "Practical strategies for routing models and graceful fallbacks to reduce latency spikes and unit cost. Live demo shows real traffic routing, quantization impacts, and a post-demo Q&A for implementation details." :thumbsup:
Maria: copyedits: change "reduce latency spikes" -> "prevent latency spikes". also add "+ monitoring hooks" at end.
Olivia: updated: "Practical strategies for routing models and graceful fallbacks to prevent latency spikes and lower unit cost, with monitoring hooks. Live demo: traffic routing, quantization impact, and a post-demo Q&A."
Samir: run-of-show draft — 45m total: 5m intro, 10m talk (routing concepts + policy), 20m live demo (bench + fallback sim), 10m Q&A. we should reserve a 2-min hotfix buffer in the demo for failover.
Alex K: looks good. add 1 slide for TL;DR + 1 slide for implementation checklist at the end.
Jordan: rehearsal availability: Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 3–4pm PT. prefer Wed.
Maria: ops checklist for live demo: 1) pre-warm dedicated pool 2) enable KV cache snapshot 3) set a fallback model variant 4) run traffic script (see snippet).
Maria: code snippet to run traffic (small script):
```bash
# load test with k6 stub
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 3m script.js
```
Samir: we also need a throttling policy for the demo in case the hosted tier gets noisy — propose routing pinned customers to dedicated during demo window.
Olivia: marketing asks: 3 bullet takeaways for the landing page + speaker bios (100 words) by Monday.
Alex K: assign: Olivia — abstract + landing bullets, Jordan — customer bio, Samir — infra bio + 1 slide on quantization tradeoffs, Maria — ops checklist + runbook, me — demo script and failover triggers.
Jordan: noted. will draft customer bio and mock datapoints (cost saved %) — will anonymize.
stage-bot: reminder: rehearsal room reserved Wed 10:00–11:00 PT (bridge: zoom.redwood.io/wr).
Alex K: ok final Qs: do we want a short pre-webinar checklist email to registrants with a lightweight pre-read? good to have a 1-pager on "what to expect" and a few prompts so attendees come with context.
Maria: yes — call it "prep for hands-on troubleshooting" — one pager + sample metrics to bring. I can draft.
Olivia: I'll put the landing page live in draft mode once I have bullets. aiming to open registration Tue morning.
Alex K: awesome. next sync: quick standup Wed 9:45am PT to verify greenroom and run the traffic script once. :rocket:
